bugs_found: apply_fee accepts negative amount; negative inputs can produce negative fees and inflate/return nonsensical balances
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal; floats or NaN-like values can break comparisons/arithmetic or create inconsistent behavior
transfer mutates account_from before account_to; if account_to.balance addition fails, balances become inconsistent and no rollback occurs
fx_convert does not validate rate positivity; zero or negative FX rates silently produce zero/negative converted amounts
compound_interest does not reject negative principal
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing inputs like 1.9 without error
finance results are not quantized/rounded to currency minor units, allowing precision drift in money-facing outputs
